scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The Phulpati dance originated in the Malwa region of Madhya Pradesh in central India.
Developed specifically within rural and semi-rural communities, the tradition emerged as a designated cultural expression for unmarried women, granting them a distinct role in seasonal celebrations.
The dance is tightly linked with major festive cycles, including the spring festival of Holi and the fifteen-day Dashain festival observed in the region.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: The primary occasion for the Phulpati dance is the festival of Holi, along with the auspicious seventh day—Phulpati—of the fifteen-day Dashain festival in Madhya Pradesh.
The main purpose of the dance style is to enable unmarried women to celebrate these key cultural moments with fanfare and vitality.

Beyond its celebratory function, the performance and its accompanying padayatra serve as an important social gathering where community members meet, exchange greetings, and strengthen local social bonds.
Today it is a living tradition.

music_brief.purpose: original soundtrack faithful to the tradition, with documented commercial reuse rights and no recurring royalties
music_brief.rights_rule: A composition brief does not clear an output. Record the provider/model/version, terms and date, input rights, output licence, restrictions and review before release.
music_brief.prompt: Original instrumental composition in the musical world of Phulpati Dance (India). Mood: celebratory, festive. New melody, new arrangement: do not quote or imitate any specific recorded song; keep the idiom, the instruments, the pulse and the proportions.

tracks.use: chapters: dance it to the music

rules: Original composition only — no sampling, no melody of any existing recording, no lyrics from any song.
Traditional public-domain tunes may be used only when the profile names them and a public-domain source is on file; otherwise compose new material in the idiom.
Keep the proportions true: the meter, the tempo range and the instrument roles the sources describe.
Label every generated track with the tool, the date and this brief, so provenance is always clear.

wardrobe.policy: the narrator wears the dance's traditional apparel, reconstructed meticulously and respectfully from the sources
wardrobe.from_sources: Visual presentation forms an essential dimension of the Phulpati dance. The dancers wear highly colourful traditional costumes complemented by beautiful ornaments. Performances take place across rural and semi-rural settlements of the Malwa region. The spatial setting frequently intersects with the padayatra, or foot procession, organised as part of the broader festival activities. These gathering routes transform open areas into festive venues where community members congregate.
care: every element traceable to the costume notes or a licensed image; nothing added for effect
no caricature, no exaggeration, no mixing of regions or eras
a culture bearer reviews the wardrobe before production; the review is recorded in the pack
credits name the tradition and the sources of the reconstruction
